login.subtitle: Connect your mailbox to AI assistants
login.passwordHint: Your usual mail password: it is checked against the mail server and never stored.

errors.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.domain_not_allowed: MailD MCP is not enabled for this domain.
errors.mail_unavailable: The mail server is not reachable right now, try again later.
errors.address_disabled_elsewhere: This address is disabled in another MailD MCP account.
errors.captcha_failed: The anti-robot check failed, try again.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.invalid_address: That is not a valid email address.
errors.not_a_mailbox: That address is not an active mailbox on this server.
errors.too_many_addresses: This account already has the maximum number of addresses.
errors.already_yours: That address is already in your account.
errors.mail_failed: The confirmation mail could not be sent, try again later.
errors.invalid_link: This confirmation link is not valid or has expired.
errors.confirmation_mismatch: Type the address exactly to confirm.
errors.invalid_name: Give the token a name (up to 100 characters).
errors.forever_not_allowed: Tokens without expiry are not allowed on this server.
errors.invalid_addresses: Choose confirmed addresses of this account.
errors.too_many_tokens: This account already has the maximum number of tokens.
errors.revoked: A revoked token cannot change any more.
errors.expired: This token has expired; create a new one.
errors.session_expired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.main_address: The main address cannot be changed here.
errors.invalid_confirm_mode: That confirmation mode is not available on this server.
errors.invalid_sender: The default sender must be a confirmed address of this account.
errors.inbox_not_hideable: INBOX cannot be hidden from agents.

confirm.title: Confirm an address
confirm.body: Confirm that this mailbox may be used by the MailD MCP account that asked for it.
confirm.done: {{address}} is now confirmed in the account of {{account}}.

account.mcpBody: Master switch for this account: when it is off, every token below is refused immediately.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.addHint: A confirmation link is mailed to that address: only someone who can read its inbox can add it.
addresses.checkInbox: Check the inbox of {{address}} for the confirmation link.

disable.title: Disable this address?
disable.body: Tokens will stop using {{address}}. A notice is sent to {{main}}.

enable.title: Enable this address?
enable.body: Tokens may use {{address}} again. A notice is sent to {{main}}.

remove.title: Remove this address?
remove.body: {{address}} leaves this account; adding it again needs a new confirmation. A notice is sent to {{main}}.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.showOnce: Copy the token now: it is shown only once.
tokens.foreverBody: Anyone holding this token can use your mailbox until you revoke it. Even so, every token is disabled after 30 days without use, and only you can re-enable it from this page.
tokens.revokeBody: "{{name}}" stops working at once and cannot be enabled again.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.confirmSend: Ask me before an agent sends mail

confirmModes.external: Only for recipients outside this server

prefs.confirmHint: When a confirmation is needed, the assistant first gets a preview and has to call again to send.
prefs.signatureHint: Appended to mail sent by agents (up to 2000 characters).
prefs.hiddenHint: Comma-separated folder names. Agents never list, search or touch them (INBOX cannot be hidden).
